svg.title: Robot Control Roadmap radial prerequisite atlas
svg.desc: A radial learning atlas with foundations near the center and advanced robot-control topics extending outward.

g.title: Calculus of variations and Pontryagin principle
Linear, nonlinear, robust, and stochastic MPC
Contact scheduling, grasping, and locomotion control
Learned dynamics, representations, and residual models
Real-time optimization, latency, and embedded control
CLFs, CBFs, reachability, and safety filters

svg.text: The full edge-level prerequisite graph is stored in roadmap-prerequisites.mmd and in the hidden Draw.io detail layer.
